_comment: ADR-037 register fragment — component-blocks. Adds a NEW disjoint schema key `componentBlock` to the shared `buildiq` register's components.schemas map (key-union merge — no existing schema is touched). A ComponentBlock is a reusable, named manifest fragment (a single captured widgetEntry, or a multi-widget page-section wrapper `{ id, widgets: [...] }`) plus capture metadata: `schemaDependencies` (de-namespaced schema slugs the fragment's `schema`/`relatedSchema` references point at, using the exact `deNamespaceSlug`/`rewriteSchemaRefs` machinery `save-as-template`'s templateCapture.js already ships) and `sourceApplicationSlug` (provenance only, never a live link). Org-scoped via OR's standard `organisation` field (D3) — no new property needed. Declarative schema metadata only (ADR-031); the capture/insert/remap logic is imperative frontend code under the structural-transform exception (see design.md's declarative-vs-imperative decision). See design.md Decisions 1-4 and specs/component-blocks/spec.md.

componentBlock.title: Component Block
componentBlock.description: A named, reusable manifest fragment captured from a configured widget or a multi-widget page section, insertable into any page/app the caller has editor rights on. Never contains object data (record rows) — only structure, matching the ApplicationTemplate 'never captures rows' guarantee. Insert always deep-copies the fragment and mints fresh widget ids; there is no live link back to the source block (explicit v1 non-goal — see proposal.md).

uuid.title: UUID
uuid.description: OpenRegister-assigned unique identifier for this block record. Not supplied by the client on create; mirrors `@self.id`.

slug.title: Block Slug
slug.description: Kebab-case unique slug for the block within its organisation.

name.title: Block Name
name.description: Human-readable name shown in the block-library panel and template-catalogue Blocks filter.

description.title: Block Description
description.description: One-line plain-English summary of what the block does.
description.example: Colour-coded status badge widget bound to a record's status field.

category.title: Category
category.description: Free-text category label used for filtering in the block-library panel and gallery (e.g. display, layout, form, navigation, data). Unlike ApplicationTemplate.category this is not a closed enum — a block's shape is more varied than a full-app template's.

schemaDependencies.title: Schema Dependencies
schemaDependencies.description: De-namespaced schema slugs the fragment's `schema`/`relatedSchema` bindings reference (captured via the same `deNamespaceSlug` logic save-as-template uses for companion schemas). Insert compares this list against the target app's schema slugs; an exact match needs no prompt, a mismatch opens BlockRemapDialog.

fragment.title: Fragment
fragment.description: The captured manifest subtree. A single-widget capture stores the widgetEntry object itself (carrying its original `id`, kept only for reference — insert always mints a fresh one). A page-section capture stores a wrapper `{ id, widgets: [...widgetEntry] }` preserving the widgets' relative layout (their `slot`/`gridX`/`gridY`/`gridWidth`/`gridHeight`). Never contains object data — structure only.

sourceApplicationSlug.title: Source Application Slug
sourceApplicationSlug.description: The slug of the Application this block was captured from. Provenance only — recorded for traceability, never a live reference; deleting or renaming the source app does not affect an already-saved block.

createdBy.title: Created By
createdBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the editor who saved this block. Set by the frontend at save time from the current user; not a live-updating owner pointer.
